description: MUIO is a graphical user interface maintained by the OSeMOSYS community for preparing and working with energy-system optimisation models. It helps users set up resource, technology, demand and planning-period assumptions for OSeMOSYS, then inspect least-cost system results subject to model constraints. Geographic coverage and horizon are set by each energy model. The GitHub repository publishes Apache-2.0 source and user instructions; the README links a separate form to obtain the Windows installer. We reviewed the public code and did not submit the form or install the program. A limitation is that the interface does not supply a validated national dataset or remove dependence on the underlying OSeMOSYS solver. MUIO can support capacity-expansion studies of electricity and fuel infrastructure. The catalogue's model-times-ireland-model is another national energy-system modelling case, not part of MUIO. The proposed MUIOGO interface is separately recorded as not yet reusable. No installer, workbook or model archive was downloaded.
name: MUIO OSeMOSYS graphical modelling interface
